correctness.rationale: The exact normalized shifted-Jacobi decomposition gives compressed multiplication B=PJP and A(t^2)=B^2+b_n^2 E. Hence [A(t),A(t^2)] is rank two with entries +/-b_n^2 b_(n-1). For fixed n,alpha, the rescaled moment blocks converge to Laguerre finite matrices; a C² boundary Taylor remainder is o(xi^-2), with a third Jacobi moment O(xi^-3) for the away-from-boundary part. After deleting scalar terms the commutator is xi^-3 times Delta/2 n(n+alpha)[M,E] plus little-o; two singular directions each have limiting coefficient c and the others are little-o. Counting two per angular block proves m³s_m->8c and Schatten iff p>1/3 for Delta!=0. Independent exact arithmetic checked leakage/rank-two constants for n=2,3,4, not the infinite-dimensional assertion. Cases Delta=0 and n varying excluded.
